release.info: Revamped type selection UI
Preparation for incorporating convolutional neural network results in the UI
Bug fixes
Added setting to allow uploads over mobile data connections
More information is now saved for each obstacle
Settings screen overhaul
Obstacle uploads to iNicosia now only happen over unmetered (e.g. WiFi) connections
First implementation of convolutional neural network for automatic obstacle recognition
Added introductory tutorial explaining the purpose of the app
All traffic between the app and the iNicosia platform now happens via HTTPS
Rudimentary support for uploading obstacles to the iNicosia platform
More details about obstacles are now saved (altitude, more orientation information etc.)
More Greek translations
Location information is now saved in Exif tags
Exif tags are preserved when photos are cropped
Greek translations
User can now manually specify location on map, or change the position automatically determined by GPS
Improved obstacle type selection UI
Final TODOs closed
Removed network tests that were used during development
Implemented support for tracking user location changes
Closed the majority of TODOs in codebase
Added check for whether GPS is on, if not now app prompts user to enable it
Added discard confirmation dialogs when user navigates away before submitting an obstacle
Major rearrangements in codebase, and more complete documentation
Added authentication functionality with Fiware Keyrock
Fixed issue with GPS coordinates caused by discrepancy of how Android and geo:json store coordinates: Android: (Lat, Long), geo:json: (Long, Lat)
App now successfully uploads obstacle photos to the server
Obstacle objects are now successfully serialized to and deserialized from JSON, so communication with server is successful
App can now push obstacle entities to Fiware's Orion (but not their photos yet)
App now supports basic connections to Fiware's Orion Broker (the functionality is only local for now)
All database transactions now happen on background threads, using Kotlin coroutines
Added "Delete all" confirmation dialog
Fixed up and back navigation by managing the fragment backstack
Added changelog
Semantic versioning for app version
Enforce obstacle type selection, by preventing submission if no selection was made
Faster loading of obstacle photo in edit fragment
Fixed back navigation in list fragment that went back to edit fragment
Added ACRA crash reporting library
Card layout in list fragment
"Delete all" button now only shows up if there are objects in the database
Various Google map view fixes, allow map scrolling
New barrier drawable
Cropping of photos now works fully, with new UI controls
All requests for permission are now handled properly
Major rearrangements in the app files, with new structure implemented
New button drawables
Expanded obstacle entity fields: added id (UUID), timestamp, type, orientation, location
Database now works fully (all actions still happen in the UI thread, however)
Obstacles shown in list fragment now originate as LiveData from the database
"Delete all" and "Add mock obstacle" buttons in list fragment
New Settings fragment
Replaced OpenStreetMap view with Google Maps view
Implemented app versioning
Removed old camera activity, and Fotoapparat camera library
Reworked ViewModel and app Repository to work with injector tools
Added About activity, that lists the open source libraries used in the app
Added user account fragment
Added message and graphic that is shown when the list fragment is empty (no obstacles to show)
